title: refactor: adjust error message text for max amount of safes in the space
description: ## Summary Resolves: [WA-2471](https://linear.app/safe-global/issue/WA-2471/wrong-wording-when-the-40-space-limit-is-reached) Problem: Fixes the confusing error message shown when adding Safes to a Space that is at its limit. Previously it read "...maximum of 40 Safe Accounts. You can only add up to 0 more.", which made no sense. Now the "add up to N more" sentence is only included when there is actually room left. ## Changes - `space-safes.repository.ts`: only append "You can only add up to N more." when `remaining > 0`; otherwise show just the limit message. - Added an integration test covering the at-limit case (message without the remaining-slots sentence).

findings.claim: The new test inserts a user, a wallet, and a member, copied from a neighboring test, even though the create() call under test only uses spaceId, so a single space row would likely suffice and the extra setup is unnecessary.

No shared helper exists for building this limit message, so the same string-construction logic is duplicated across the three repositories; extracting it into one small shared helper would prevent the fix from being applied inconsistently.

This repository still builds the limit message as `You can only add up to ${max - existing} more.` with no guard, so users at the limit see "up to 0 more" and users over the limit see a negative number.

The new test only covers the remaining === 0 case; there is no test for existing > max (the case that previously produced "add up to -N more"), so that branch of the guard is unverified even though the same > 0 check handles it.

This repository still produces the old wording ('You can only add up to 0 more.') when the limit is reached, so its error message is now inconsistent with the fixed message in the sibling space-safes repository.
This e2e test still asserts the old "…up to 0 more." text, so it would need updating once the same fix is applied to the address-book repositories.
This repository has the same unguarded message-construction pattern, producing "up to 0 more" or a negative remaining count instead of the corrected wording applied elsewhere.

This repository still produces the old wording ('You can only add up to 0 more.') when the limit is reached, so its error message is now inconsistent with the fixed message in the sibling space-safes repository.

If maxSafesPerSpace is lowered in config below the number of Safes a Space already has, the remaining count becomes negative, and before this change that produced a message reading 'up to -N more'; no test covers this edge case after the fix.
The limit check reads the current count and performs the insert as two separate, non-atomic operations, so two concurrent requests could both pass the check and together exceed the configured limit.

This e2e test still asserts the old error text '...maximum of 1 Address Book Items. You can only add up to 0 more.', which will need to be updated if the other repositories' messages are ever fixed to match, since the three Workspace limit errors now read differently from one another.
